topics.digest: Specific rule wins; selective tests; tool fix before new rule.

Protected projects: counts only; no private data in shared places.
Busy = CPU or memory (budgit busy); heavy work waits, thinking never.
Every OS branch tested; optional tools name a fallback.
Coordinator and leads think and route; workers do; escalate up.
Opt-in keep-alive, stand-up and cleanup; jobs never message, push or publish.
Record decisions at once; triage each note; bugs lead; never FIFO.

Ship each green set; only reviewed tips; gates; docs per publish.
Incident: evidence, root cause, tool first, external check; done-check fields.
Self-check design and scale before showing it.
Selective tests; full on triggers; green = modules loaded equal files.
No verifier on open work; two holds then change approach.
Second-family review, read-only, untrusted; name the fallback reviewer.
